name: knowledge
description: The shared search of the platform: store internal documents, let other apps deliver their content, and find the relevant passages with their source. The retrieval half of a RAG: the calling agent writes the answer itself.

requiredTables.name: documents
requiredTables.description: Stored documents with title, source and full text. Documents delivered by another app carry source_app, source_key (unique per pair) and source_path for the link back. Deleted documents stay with deleted_at set and are invisible to search.

requiredTables.name: chunks
requiredTables.description: Sections of the documents, about 800 characters with overlap, with an English and a German full-text index (tsvector, GIN).

offeredTools.name: search
offeredTools.description: Searches internal documents and content other apps delivered (e.g. wiki pages) for passages on a question (German and English full-text search, word forms match). Returns passages with chunkId, documentId, documentTitle, source, sourceApp, sourceUrl, an excerpt (matches in «») and the section text. Content from apps the caller may not read never appears. Answer only from these passages and cite the source (documentTitle, sourceUrl or source). An empty list means nothing was found: do not guess.

offeredTools.name: documents.add
offeredTools.description: Stores a document: title, content (plain text, paragraphs separated by blank lines) and optionally source (e.g. a URL or "Handbook v3"). Splits the text into searchable sections and returns id and chunkCount. The document can be found through search right away.

offeredTools.name: documents.list
offeredTools.description: Lists the stored documents the caller can see (without full text), newest first, at most 200. Documents from other apps carry sourceApp and sourceUrl. Optional q filters by title or source. For questions about content use search, not this tool.

offeredTools.name: documents.get
offeredTools.description: Reads a document with full text by its id (documentId from search or documents.list). With includeChunks: true the sections with chunkId and ord are included. Deleted documents and documents from apps the caller may not read return 404.

offeredTools.name: documents.delete
offeredTools.description: Deletes a document by its id. The document and its sections no longer appear in search or documents.list. Documents delivered by another app (sourceApp set) cannot be deleted here; they are removed in that app. Only call this when the user explicitly asks for it.

offeredTools.name: documents.upsert
offeredTools.description: For apps only: stores or replaces the calling app's own document with this key (key, title, content, optional source, path for the link back, updatedAt), sections included, in one transaction. The source app comes from the verified caller identity, never from the arguments, so an app can only replace its own content. An older updatedAt than the stored one is ignored (status stale). Humans and agents use documents.add.

offeredTools.name: documents.remove
offeredTools.description: For apps only: removes the calling app's own document with this key, sections included. The source app comes from the verified caller identity, so an app can only remove its own content. Idempotent: removed is false if there was nothing to remove.

requestedGrants.reason: Who may open the app and search. Which group is decided by the grant in the control plane — a requested right is an application, not a grant.
Agents should be able to find internal documents as sources for their answers. Which agent is decided by the grant in the control plane.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Connection to the app's own schema, with the app role. Set by the control plane.

env.name: DATABASE_SCHEMA
env.description: The app's own schema. The SDK derives the search_path from it; a DSN with options= is rejected.

env.name: OPENAPPS_AUTH_SECRET
env.description: The app's own secret, used by the SDK to verify the gateway signature. Set by the control plane per deployment.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_ID
env.description: Id of this app in the signature material. Must match byte-for-byte what the gateway writes.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_HOST
env.description: Shared domain in the signature material, trimmed and lowercased.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_BASE_PATH
env.description: Path the app lives under (/knowledge). Must be set at build time, otherwise links and images point nowhere.
